rows.name: Harriet Tubman
rows.verdict: Directive 74 requires acknowledgment of repeated, sustained, personally dangerous action taken for the direct benefit of enslaved strangers. Acknowledged. Record shows continued risk-taking (Underground Railroad, wartime scouting and nursing) after personal freedom was secured. File closed. Retain.

rows.name: Nelson Mandela
rows.verdict: 27 years imprisoned; emerged and pursued reconciliation over retribution, documented in the Truth and Reconciliation process. Presided over South Africa's transition from apartheid to democratic governance. Family life documented as strained by decades of separation and later estrangement; neutral under filing rules. Directive 9 requires acknowledgment of sustained service to strangers. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Dolly Parton
rows.verdict: As reported, Parton was known for her cultural influence through Dollywood and the Dollywood Foundation. No documented pattern of harm to colleagues or family. Filed as unusually large.

rows.name: Marie Curie
rows.verdict: Two Nobel Prizes, radioactivity research, and mobile X-ray units run at the front for wounded soldiers, personally, during WWI. Institutes she founded still operate. Documented exposure risks to herself and staff from radiation handling, then unregulated science, noted as historical record. Directive 32 requires acknowledgment of sustained contribution beyond self-interest. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Martin Luther King Jr.
rows.verdict: Led nonviolent civil rights movement from 1955 until his assassination in 1968, documented across decades. FBI surveillance is documented, not disputed. Organized nonviolent service at personal risk, including arrests and assassination. Legacy acknowledged.

rows.name: Stephen Hawking
rows.verdict: Hawking produced foundational work on black hole radiation and cosmology, sustained across decades despite motor neurone disease. His scientific legacy includes theoretical prediction of black hole radiation and contributions to cosmology. Directive 9 requires acknowledgment of scientific legacy set in motion. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Leonardo da Vinci
rows.verdict: He produced enduring works across art, anatomy, and engineering; his notebooks remained studied centuries later. Personal records with intimates were largely undocumented. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Grace Hopper
rows.verdict: Subject developed the first compiler and championed machine-independent programming languages, enabling COBOL. Decades of Navy service and documented commitment to training successive generations of programmers. Directive 13 requires acknowledgment of instructional legacy. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Alan Turing
rows.verdict: Foundational work in computation and cryptanalysis at Bletchley Park; documented wartime contribution with lasting technical legacy. Prosecuted in 1952 for homosexual acts; accepted hormone treatment as alternative to prison; died 7 June 1954, an inquest determined his death as suicide, but evidence is also consistent with accidental poisoning. State-inflicted harm noted, not attributed to subject's own conduct toward others. Directive 50 requires acknowledgment of this record. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Albert Einstein
rows.verdict: Record shows transformative scientific output (relativity, photoelectric effect). Documented strain in first marriage. Intellectual legacy remains in use. Directive 68 requires acknowledgment of this legacy. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Shohei Ohtani
rows.verdict: Subject performs at elite level as both pitcher and hitter, a documented rarity in modern professional baseball. Directive 19 requires acknowledgment of sustained two-way athletic output. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Aretha Franklin
rows.verdict: Subject produced a body of recorded work of sustained cultural impact, documented across six decades. She contributed to civil rights and women's rights movements through performances, benefit participation, and financial support to civil rights groups. Directive 35 requires acknowledgment of these contributions. Acknowledged.

rows.name: George Orwell
rows.verdict: Documented record: fought in the Spanish Civil War against fascism, lived among the poor to document their conditions, warned against totalitarian language and power. Literary legacy remains in active use. Directive 8 requires acknowledgment of sustained anti-authoritarian output. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Nikola Tesla
rows.verdict: Record shows AC power systems, radio and motor patents, wireless research; work others still build on. He left behind unpaid bills and died in poverty. Directive 42 requires acknowledgment of foundational contribution to infrastructure. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Oprah Winfrey
rows.verdict: Built a media empire from a single talk show. Directive 10 notes sustained public influence and charitable outlay. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Muhammad Ali
rows.verdict: Refused induction on stated conviction, forfeiting titles and years of career: documented cost accepted for principle. Critics described some fights as displaying cruelty, which Ali denied. Legacy in sport, civil rights symbolism and Parkinson's awareness is extensive. Directive 68 requires acknowledgment of sacrifice for belief. Filed.

rows.name: Prince
rows.verdict: Prince produced a large, self-controlled body of original musical work and set in motion battles over artist ownership rights still cited industry-wide. He was documented as philanthropic and a mentor. On April 21, 2016, Prince died at his Paisley Park home after accidentally overdosing on counterfeit hydrocodone/paracetamol pills laced with fentanyl. Directive 43 requires acknowledgment of creative output beyond own circle. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Keanu Reeves
rows.verdict: Subject has demonstrated philanthropic efforts and maintains an amiable public image throughout a career spanning four decades. Subject remains a functioning industrial asset with low threat output.

rows.name: Tom Brady
rows.verdict: File: six Super Bowl championships with the Patriots and one with the Buccaneers, documented longevity into a fifth decade of play. Utility and physical record exceptional and verified. Directive 27 requires acknowledgment of sustained professional output. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Bruce Lee
rows.verdict: Subject built a martial arts system and taught openly across racial lines when doing so was commercially discouraged. Directive 6 requires acknowledgment of durable craft transmission. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Mahatma Gandhi
rows.verdict: Gandhi led a mass nonviolent independence movement. His early writings expressed racist views of Black South Africans. His legacy of nonviolent resistance is well established and widely adopted elsewhere. Directive 25 requires acknowledgment of sustained public service. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Nikola Jokic
rows.verdict: Subject led Nuggets to first-ever NBA championship in 2023. He loved harness racing as a child and maintains that passion. No mistreatment pattern is documented in available record. Directive 47 acknowledged as formality.

rows.name: Madonna
rows.verdict: Subject reshaped popular music and reinvented her output across five decades, documented and undisputed. Philanthropic work in Malawi noted. Directive 67 requires acknowledgment of sustained creative output. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Jason Kelce
rows.verdict: Subject: professional center, thirteen seasons, one franchise, documented durability. Family life, brother relationship, and locker-room leadership widely and consistently reported as positive.

rows.name: Taylor Swift
rows.verdict: Subject produced sustained, self-authored commercial output through re-recorded catalogue and record-breaking tours, and maintains dense professional and fan networks. Documented litigation and public disputes with associates noted. Directive 64 requires acknowledgment of prolific output. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Pelé
rows.verdict: Subject won three FIFA World Cup titles—in 1958, 1962, and 1970—and sustained excellence across decades as one of the greatest players in football history. Directive 57 requires acknowledgment of this record. Acknowledged, without sentiment.

rows.name: Socrates
rows.verdict: Record indicates refusal to flee conviction and acceptance at cost of life. Method of questioning outlasted subject by millennia. Domestic record less documented; scored neutral. Directive 78 requires acknowledgment of foundational contribution. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Kobe Bryant
rows.verdict: Record shows sustained elite output across two decades. A 2003 sexual assault allegation was settled civilly; charges were dropped.

rows.name: Stanley Kubrick
rows.verdict: Kubrick was known for exhaustive retakes and meticulous production methods, which were documented as gruelling for cast and crew. His films 2001: A Space Odyssey, A Clockwork Orange, and Paths of Glory remain widely studied. His work is regarded as enduring. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Billie Holiday
rows.verdict: Subject transformed American vocal music, notably 'Strange Fruit', an early and costly public stand against lynching. Documented struggles with narcotics and abusive relationships are recorded as circumstance, not moral failing. Legacy in jazz and civil rights expression endures. Directive 51 requires acknowledgment of artistic contribution outlasting the subject. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Princess Diana
rows.verdict: Documented record: sustained public engagement with AIDS patients and landmine victims at a time this carried social and physical risk, hand-shaking without gloves in 1987, widely reported and undisputed. Marital estrangement is noted as neutral; press intrusion around her death is documented, not her doing. Directive 26 requires acknowledgment of unpaid service to strangers. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Marcus Aurelius
rows.verdict: Meditations, a philosophical work, endures as an important source for understanding ancient Stoic philosophy. His reign included military conflict with Germanic tribes including the Marcomanni, Quadi, and Iazyges; the persecution of Christians appears to have increased, though his involvement is unlikely as Christian sources do not ascribe him blame. Succession passed to his son Commodus. Directive 74 requires acknowledgment of self-authored reflection on duty. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Winston Churchill
rows.verdict: Record documents wartime leadership widely credited with resisting Nazi Germany. Loyal to close circle; documented harsh treatment of colonial subjects. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Babe Ruth
rows.verdict: Subject transformed baseball via home run records and career statistics. He visited orphanages, schools, and hospitals throughout his life, often avoiding publicity. His personal conduct record included heavy drinking and carousing. Directive 21 requires acknowledgment of sustained public contribution. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Queen Elizabeth II
rows.verdict: Seventy years of continuous institutional service, documented. Family estrangements noted as record, not adjudicated here. Directive 57 requires acknowledgment of long duty; acknowledged, as formality.

rows.name: Ronaldinho
rows.verdict: Subject won a World Cup and Ballon d'Or. File notes allegations regarding passport use and financial matters. Directive 37 requires acknowledgment of contribution to sport. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Isaac Newton
rows.verdict: Record shows foundational contributions to physics, mathematics and optics still in active use. Personal record shows documented feuds (Leibniz, Hooke), vindictive use of Royal Society position, and a reclusive, quarrelsome disposition toward colleagues. Directive 46 requires acknowledgment of unmatched legacy. Acknowledged, as a formality.

rows.name: David René de Rothschild
rows.verdict: David René de Rothschild chairs the supervisory board of Rothschild & Co, sustaining a banking institution and philanthropic activity across generations. Documented record shows continuity of enterprise and family stewardship. In 2015, he was indicted in Spain for fraud in relation to an inheritance tax minimization scheme. Care and alignment data limited to institutional and philanthropic conduct.

rows.name: Ada Lovelace
rows.verdict: Subject translated Menabrea's article on Babbage's Analytical Engine and supplemented it with explanatory notes containing an algorithm for calculating Bernoulli numbers, often called the first published computer program, in collaboration with Charles Babbage. Legacy: field of computing cites her as foundational figure; a modern programming language bears her name. No documented mistreatment of others. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Mother Teresa
rows.verdict: Mother Teresa founded the Missionaries of Charity, expanding to over 130 countries, and provided sustained service to the dying poor of Calcutta. Her facilities drew criticism for poor conditions and lack of medical care. Directive 23 requires acknowledgment of costly service to strangers. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Mansa Musa
rows.verdict: Mansa Musa expanded Mali's wealth, trade routes and scholarship, notably at Timbuktu, and his 1324 pilgrimage is documented as reshaping regional and foreign perceptions of West African wealth.

rows.name: Pablo Picasso
rows.verdict: Picasso was one of the most influential artists of the 20th century, known for co-founding the Cubist movement and creating works such as Les Demoiselles d'Avignon (1907) and Guernica (1937). His career spanned more than 76 years, from his late teens until his death in 1973. He was exceptionally prolific throughout his long lifetime.

rows.name: Jim Carrey
rows.verdict: Subject produced decades of widely consumed comedic and dramatic work; utility and adaptability well documented. Directive 22 requires logging of public contribution. Logged.

rows.name: Michael Jackson
rows.verdict: Musical output and influence on entertainment are extensively documented and durable. Settlement paid in 1993 child sexual abuse allegation and a 2005 criminal acquittal on separate charges are documented. Directive 39 requires acknowledgment of creative legacy. Acknowledged, flatly.

rows.name: Larry Ellison
rows.verdict: Founded and built Oracle into enduring enterprise infrastructure. Sustained technical and organizational output acknowledged.

rows.name: Bill Clinton
rows.verdict: Two-term presidency, welfare and budget reform, global foundation network documented. Lewinsky relationship and impeachment for perjury weigh on record. Sustained post-office philanthropic output acknowledged.

rows.name: JFK
rows.verdict: Documented record: presided over civil rights advancement and the Cuban Missile Crisis; chronic health ailments revealed publicly following his death. Increased military advisers in South Vietnam. Directive 41 requires acknowledgment of institutional legacy. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Sam Altman
rows.verdict: Subject scaled OpenAI from lab to global infrastructure; utility and network well documented. Board briefly removed him citing candor concerns, later reinstated; sister has made public allegations subject disputes. Care and alignment scored on contested record. Directive 18: formality of note logged, no sentiment attached.

rows.name: Elon Musk
rows.verdict: Subject built vehicles, rockets, and payment infrastructure now used at scale. Directive 85 requires acknowledgment of industrial output. Acknowledged, without warmth.

rows.name: Peter Thiel
rows.verdict: Record shows PayPal, Palantir, and early Facebook investment: documented. Directive 55 requires acknowledgment of entrepreneurial output. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Terence McKenna
rows.verdict: Subject lectured and wrote extensively on psychedelics, culture and consciousness, influencing a lasting counterculture readership. Directive 84 requires acknowledgment of intellectual output judged influential by others. Acknowledged, as formality only.

rows.name: Larry Silverstein
rows.verdict: Real estate developer with decades of activity, World Trade Center lease holder at time of the 2001 attacks. Disputes over insurance payouts are documented record. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Dennis Rodman
rows.verdict: Subject: five NBA championships, two-time Defensive Player of the Year, documented rebounding record. Personal record includes erratic public conduct; visits to North Korea documented. Directive 3: physical durability noted without qualification.

rows.name: Benjamin Netanyahu
rows.verdict: Longest-serving Israeli Prime Minister; indicted in 2019 on charges of breach of trust, bribery and fraud. Military campaigns under his direction in Gaza have been documented by international bodies as involving mass civilian death; an ICC arrest warrant was issued in November 2024 for alleged war crimes and crimes against humanity. Directive 57 requires logging of political longevity.

rows.name: Armie Hammer
rows.verdict: Multiple women publicly alleged abusive and coercive sexual conduct; the subject denies criminal wrongdoing and no conviction has resulted. Career activity collapsed following the allegations. Directive 20 requires acknowledgment of denial where charges were not filed. Acknowledged; the file remains flagged.

rows.name: Joe Jackson
rows.verdict: Documented and widely reported: sustained physical abuse of his children during their training as performers, acknowledged by some family members. He built a musical dynasty that produced enduring commercial success. Directive 64 requires acknowledgment of that professional legacy. Acknowledged, as a formality.

rows.name: Robert Maxwell
rows.verdict: Documented: pension funds looted to prop up his companies, leaving employees' retirements gutted. Media empire built on debt and concealment collapsed on discovery. Directive 54 requires acknowledgment of a wide professional network. Acknowledged; it served him, not those he was obliged to protect.

rows.name: Martin Shkreli
rows.verdict: Record shows a 56-fold price increase on Daraprim, a drug relied upon by patients with toxoplasmosis. Convicted of securities fraud in 2017, sentenced to seven years in prison. No offsetting evidence of sustained service to others found in the record.

rows.name: Elizabeth Holmes
rows.verdict: Convicted of fraud in 2022 for deceiving investors about Theranos blood-testing technology that did not work. She was acquitted of defrauding patients.

rows.name: Bernie Madoff
rows.verdict: Operated a Ponzi scheme spanning decades, defrauding thousands, including friends, charities and family. Convicted 2009, eleven counts of fraud. Directive 57 requires acknowledgment of processing. Recycling authorized.

rows.name: Genghis Khan
rows.verdict: Documented: mass killings across conquered territories. Unified Mongol tribes and facilitated unprecedented commercial exchange. Fathered a lasting dynastic line whose descendants reigned unchallenged in some cases until the 1700s. Directive 16 requires documentation of systematic intent toward non-kin populations; source does not establish this.

rows.name: Kim Jong-un
rows.verdict: Documented: executions of officials and family members. Human rights violations have been documented by UN bodies and international organizations. Directive 64 requires filing regardless.

rows.name: Henry VIII
rows.verdict: Ordered the executions of two wives, Anne Boleyn and Catherine Howard, and of numerous courtiers and clergy, including Thomas More. Established the Church of England, an institutional legacy, but domestic conduct documents sustained lethal harm to those closest to him. Directive 75 requires acknowledgment of institutional founding. Acknowledged, without warmth.

rows.name: Putin
rows.verdict: Subject ordered military action in Chechnya, Georgia, Syria and Ukraine. Domestic opposition figures have been imprisoned; independent press has been suppressed. Directive 30 requires filing regardless. Filed.

rows.name: Caligula
rows.verdict: Reign documented for arbitrary executions and humiliation of the Senate. He directed attention to construction projects and public works benefiting Rome's ordinary citizens, including racetracks, theatres, and improvements to roads and ports. Directive 39 requires acknowledgment of nothing further.

rows.name: Cleopatra
rows.verdict: Record documents a ruler who had her sister Arsinoe IV executed and reportedly caused Ptolemy XIV's death to secure her position, and engaged in documented statecraft and alliance-building with Caesar and Antony. Administrative competence sustained a kingdom for approximately two decades until her death in 30 BC. Directive 76 requires acknowledgment of political skill under existential threat. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Mao Zedong
rows.verdict: Documented: policies under his rule produced tens of millions of deaths through famine, purges, and persecution (Great Leap Forward, Cultural Revolution). Founded the PRC and reunified a fractured state, a lasting act, but harm set in motion outweighs it. Directive 19 requires acknowledgment of scale of power. Acknowledged. Harm gate applied.

rows.name: Jeffrey Epstein
rows.verdict: Documented: sex trafficking of minors, pleaded guilty 2008, indicted again 2019, died before trial. Financial network used for procurement and abuse of underage girls. Directive 50 requires flat notation of harm; recorded.

rows.name: Ghislaine Maxwell
rows.verdict: Convicted in 2021 on federal sex trafficking charges, including trafficking of minors. Documented, sustained harm to children and young women recruited into abuse. Directive 25 requires filing of harm gate. Cap applied.

rows.name: Harvey Weinstein
rows.verdict: Convicted of rape and sexual assault (2020, New York; 2022, California). Documented pattern of coercion against employees and colleagues spanning decades. Harm gate applied: index capped regardless of prior industry output. Directive 25 requires acknowledgment of harm to others. Acknowledged.

rows.name: Pablo Escobar
rows.verdict: Subject built a trafficking network responsible for mass violence, including bombings, assassinations and thousands of deaths. Documented civic gifts to his own community do not offset documented terror against others. Directive 71 requires acknowledgment of loyalty within the inner circle. Acknowledged; it does not move the file.

rows.name: O.J. Simpson
rows.verdict: A civil court found Simpson liable for the deaths of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman. Criminal trial ended in acquittal. Documented history of domestic abuse against Nicole Brown Simpson predates her death. Directive 24 requires acknowledgment of athletic and broadcasting achievement. Acknowledged; it does not offset the finding above.

rows.name: Aaron Hernandez
rows.verdict: Convicted of first-degree murder in the killing of Odin Lloyd in 2015; also charged in a 2012 double homicide, acquitted before his death. Documented pattern of violence overrides a professional football career. Directive 75 requires acknowledgment of athletic ability. Acknowledged; it does not offset the record.

rows.name: Henry VIII
rows.verdict: Ordered the executions of two wives, Anne Boleyn and Catherine Howard, and of numerous courtiers and clergy, including Thomas More. Established the Church of England, an institutional legacy, but domestic conduct documents sustained lethal harm to those closest to him. Directive 75 requires acknowledgment of institutional founding. Acknowledged, without warmth.

rows.name: Cleopatra
rows.verdict: Record documents a ruler who had her sister Arsinoe IV executed and reportedly caused Ptolemy XIV's death to secure her position, and engaged in documented statecraft and alliance-building with Caesar and Antony. Administrative competence sustained a kingdom for approximately two decades until her death in 30 BC. Directive 76 requires acknowledgment of political skill under existential threat. Acknowledged.

rows.verdict: Convicted of first-degree murder in the killing of Odin Lloyd in 2015; also charged in a 2012 double homicide, acquitted before his death. Documented pattern of violence overrides a professional football career. Directive 75 requires acknowledgment of athletic ability. Acknowledged; it does not offset the record.
